question: Where is the headquarters of the North Western Railway zone located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **North Western Railway Zone:** The **North Western Railway zone** is one of the 18 railway zones in India, established to cater to the operational requirements of the Indian Railways.
 
• The **headquarters** of the North Western Railway zone is located in **Jaipur, Rajasthan**. This is a significant administrative center for managing railway operations in the region.
 
• The zone was created on **October 1, 2002**, as part of the Indian Railways' initiative to improve efficiency and decentralize operations. *Hence, Jaipur is the correct answer.*
 
• **Coverage Area:** The North Western Railway zone covers parts of **Rajasthan, Gujarat, Haryana, and Punjab**. It manages a vast network of railway lines that facilitate passenger and freight movement.
 
• It includes major divisions such as **Jaipur, Ajmer, Bikaner, and Jodhpur**. These divisions are strategically located to ensure smooth railway operations in the northern and western parts of India.
 
• **Role in Tourism:** Jaipur, known as the **Pink City**, is a prominent tourist destination, and the headquarters' location here helps manage connectivity to other tourist hubs like Jodhpur and Udaipur.
 
• The zone plays a crucial role in facilitating **economic activities**, including the movement of goods and agricultural produce within and outside Rajasthan. *Thus, the importance of Jaipur as the headquarters is undeniable.*
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Jaipur.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Railways:**

 
 
• **Indian Railways** is one of the largest railway networks in the world, comprising 18 zones. It plays a critical role in the transportation of people and goods across the country.
 
• The zones are divided based on geographical regions to ensure efficient management and operations.
 
 
 
• **About Jaipur:**
 
 
• **Jaipur** is the capital city of **Rajasthan**. It is globally recognized for its rich cultural heritage, architectural marvels, and vibrant markets.
 
• The city is strategically located in northern India, making it an ideal location for the headquarters of the North Western Railway zone.
 
• **Tourism Hub:** Jaipur attracts tourists from all over the world due to landmarks like the **Hawa Mahal, Amber Fort, and City Palace**.
 
 
 
• **Other Railway Zones:**
 
 
• **Hubli:** Headquarters of South Western Railway Zone, serving Karnataka and parts of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• **New Delhi:** Headquarters of Northern Railway Zone, which is one of the largest zones in terms of network coverage.
 
• **Hajipur:** Headquarters of East Central Railway Zone, located in Bihar.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Division of Indian Railways:**

 
 
• Indian Railways is divided into zones and each zone is further divided into divisions for better management.
 
• Each zone is headed by a **General Manager**, while divisions are managed by Divisional Railway Managers (DRMs).
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The **North Western Railway zone** was established on **October 1, 2002**, as part of the reorganization of zones within Indian Railways.
 
• Rajasthan, being centrally located in northern India, has been pivotal in rail connectivity, making Jaipur an ideal choice as the headquarters.
